title: Aaron Sorkin on why he's optimistic about AI: 'I don't think it's going to work'
excerpt: Aaron Sorkin said he saw an AI-generated painting at a party. He said it taught him that human art will be just fine.
content_html:
By Ben Shimkus

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Aaron Sorkin is surprisingly upbeat about AI. It's mostly because he doesn't think it'll make good art.

During an interview with Esquire's "What I've Learned" podcast, released on Wednesday, the "West Wing" and "The Social Network" creator responded to a question about technology in Hollywood.

"I have a very optimistic view of our future with AI," the award-winning writer answered. "And here's why: I don't think it's going to work."

He recalled seeing an abstract painting at a party. When its owner revealed that it was computer-generated, he said the art lost its emotional connection.

"I was impressed by the technology that could do that," Sorkin said. "But whatever I was feeling about this painting was gone."

He said he believes the same lack of emotional, human connection would apply to AI-generated films. He also pointed to violent video games with highly realistic avatars, and said players "don't have any emotional connection to the people that they're shooting at all."

The interview comes as Sorkin's next film, "The Social Reckoning" — a follow-up to his 2010 movie about Facebook's rise — is scheduled to hit theaters on October 9.

His latest movie centers on Facebook whistleblower Frances Haugen, and the internal documents behind The Wall Street Journal's "Facebook Files" investigation.

Representatives for Sorkin didn't immediately respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.

content_html_zh:
作者：Ben Shimkus 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

亚伦·索金 (Aaron Sorkin) 对人工智能出奇地乐观。 这主要是因为他认为这不会成为好的艺术。

在接受《时尚先生》周三发布的“我学到的东西”播客采访时，这位《白宫风云》和《社交网络》的创作者回答了有关好莱坞技术的问题。

“我对人工智能的未来抱有非常乐观的看法，”这位获奖作家回答道。 “原因如下：我认为这不会起作用。”

他记得在一次聚会上看到一幅抽象画。 当它的主人透露它是计算机生成的时，他说这件艺术品失去了情感联系。

“能够做到这一点的技术给我留下了深刻的印象，”索金说。 “但是我对这幅画的所有感觉都消失了。”

他说，他相信同样缺乏情感和人际联系的情况也适用于人工智能生成的电影。 他还指出，暴力视频游戏的头像高度真实，玩家“与他们所射击的人根本没有任何情感联系”。

此次采访正值索尔金的下一部电影《社会清算》——他在 2010 年拍摄的有关 Facebook 崛起的电影的续集——计划于 10 月 9 日上映。

他的最新电影以 Facebook 举报人弗朗西斯·豪根 (Frances Haugen) 以及《华尔街日报》“Facebook 文件”调查背后的内部文件为中心。

索金的代表没有立即回应《商业内幕》的置评请求。
